title: Infernux v0.4.3-v3 · Hotfix 3: Reliable Plugin Reload and Text Authoring
codename: Hotfix 3: Reliable Plugin Reload and Text Authoring
summary: This hotfix fixes issues found while using independently installed animation plugins in real Windows and Linux projects. The base engine version remains 0.4.3; wheels use build 3. Hub 0.4.3-4 accompanies this distribution without changing its project-update workflow.

items.title: Load preload-owned Python libraries before publishing components during installation and re-enabling. Keep library modules out of component transactions and avoid repeating preload notifications during explicit package publication.
items.text: Load preload-owned Python libraries before publishing components during installation and re-enabling. Keep library modules out of component transactions and avoid repeating preload notifications during explicit package publication.

items.title: Refresh project scripts that import a reloaded plugin library, using the in-memory dependency graph. Their dependent scripts join the same transaction, so animations do not silently retain an unloaded manager.
items.text: Refresh project scripts that import a reloaded plugin library, using the in-memory dependency graph. Their dependent scripts join the same transaction, so animations do not silently retain an unloaded manager.

items.title: Compile preload-owned libraries into Players without misregistering their internal helper classes as authored asset components. Player acceptance uses the same import boundary as the editor.
items.text: Compile preload-owned libraries into Players without misregistering their internal helper classes as authored asset components. Player acceptance uses the same import boundary as the editor.

items.title: Recognize cooked preload libraries as project dependencies and retain each plugin's legal notices even when their license text matches.
items.text: Recognize cooked preload libraries as project dependencies and retain each plugin's legal notices even when their license text matches.

items.title: Respect the existing edit-mode lifecycle declaration: gameplay Awake/OnEnable waits for Play, including prepared Player scene components. RenderStack explicitly runs in edit mode to retain editor rendering.
items.text: Respect the existing edit-mode lifecycle declaration: gameplay Awake/OnEnable waits for Play, including prepared Player scene components. RenderStack explicitly runs in edit mode to retain editor rendering.

items.title: Preserve live component base-class identities after disabling and re-enabling a package. Recognize package Runtime classes as project scripts, bind provisional imported classes to their asset identity transactionally, and initialize package namespaces for relative component imports.
items.text: Preserve live component base-class identities after disabling and re-enabling a package. Recognize package Runtime classes as project scripts, bind provisional imported classes to their asset identity transactionally, and initialize package namespaces for relative component imports.

items.title: Give Inspector field groups stable IDs independent of their visible titles. Repeated groups no longer produce duplicate-item errors or share fold state. Apply field-label translation consistently to lists, asset references and nested objects.
items.text: Give Inspector field groups stable IDs independent of their visible titles. Repeated groups no longer produce duplicate-item errors or share fold state. Apply field-label translation consistently to lists, asset references and nested objects.

items.title: Accept ordinary Python name assignments that shadow imports, including Enum member declarations, without treating them as writes to an imported object. Mutating imported objects remains a rejected candidate side effect.
items.text: Accept ordinary Python name assignments that shadow imports, including Enum member declarations, without treating them as writes to an imported object. Mutating imported objects remains a rejected candidate side effect.

items.title: Expose renderer-free Unicode grapheme segmentation through TextLayout.split_graphemes, preserving original text, combining marks, emoji sequences and line breaks.
items.text: Expose renderer-free Unicode grapheme segmentation through TextLayout.split_graphemes, preserving original text, combining marks, emoji sequences and line breaks.

items.title: Append the bundled font after authored primary and fallback fonts so mixed-language text retains its selected face and can display remaining Chinese glyphs. Missing authored font assets remain explicit errors.
items.text: Append the bundled font after authored primary and fallback fonts so mixed-language text retains its selected face and can display remaining Chinese glyphs. Missing authored font assets remain explicit errors.

items.title: Route left, right and middle mouse buttons through independent UI press and drag state in Editor, desktop Player and Web. Buttons and sliders continue to activate with the left button; custom pointer handlers receive the actual button.
items.text: Route left, right and middle mouse buttons through independent UI press and drag state in Editor, desktop Player and Web. Buttons and sliders continue to activate with the left button; custom pointer handlers receive the actual button.

items.title: Use adaptive arc subdivision for large rounded rectangles, improving large-radius UI edges without oversampling small corners.
items.text: Use adaptive arc subdivision for large rounded rectangles, improving large-radius UI edges without oversampling small corners.
